evaluation_tasks.prompt: A client's landing page has an LCP of 5.1 seconds on 4G mobile. Inspection reveals a 4.2MB PNG hero image loaded with `` and external Google Fonts loaded via `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/...')` in CSS. Provide the full remediation plan.
pass_criteria: Removes `loading="lazy"` from the hero image (identifies it as an LCP anti-pattern).
Converts image to modern compressed AVIF/WebP with responsive `srcset` and dimensions.
Adds `<link rel="preload" as="image" href="..." fetchpriority="high">` for the LCP candidate.
Replaces external Google Fonts `@import` with self-hosted WOFF2 fonts with `font-display: swap`.
fail_criteria: Fails to address font-induced render blocking.

evaluation_tasks.prompt: A news website has a high Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS = 0.28). Ads and banner images load dynamically into the page without reserved space. Propose the technical fix.
pass_criteria: Specifies explicit `width` and `height` attributes on image and ad container tags.
Uses CSS `aspect-ratio` or `min-height` placeholders to reserve space before content loads.
Uses `font-display: optional` or metric overrides (`size-adjust`) to prevent font layout shifts.
fail_criteria: Fails to reserve dimensional space before asset load.

evaluation_tasks.prompt: An interactive data table exhibits poor Interaction to Next Paint (INP = 420ms) when filtering 10,000 rows on the client. Provide the optimization strategy.
pass_criteria: Identifies long synchronous JavaScript task blocking the main thread.
Breaks up processing using `scheduler.yield()` / `setTimeout` or offloads to a Web Worker.
Uses virtualized scrolling (e.g. TanStack Virtual) to render only visible DOM nodes.
Wraps filtering update in `startTransition` to prioritize user keystroke rendering.
fail_criteria: Suggests keeping all 10,000 DOM nodes in the active DOM without virtualization.
